'''''Project Hail Mary''''' is a 2021 [[hard science fiction]] novel by American writer [[Andy Weir]]. It centers on science teacher and former biologist Ryland Grace, who wakes up aboard a spacecraft, afflicted with [[amnesia]].

''Project Hail Mary'' received generally positive reviews and was a finalist for the 2022 [[Hugo Award for Best Novel]].<ref name="hugo">{{cite web|title=2022 Hugo Awards|url=https://www.thehugoawards.org/hugo-history/2022-hugo-awards/|website=The Hugo Awards|date=April 7, 2022|access-date=8 June 2022|archive-date=April 11, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220411174235/https://www.thehugoawards.org/hugo-history/2022-hugo-awards/|url-status=live}}</ref> The unabridged [[audiobook]] was read by [[Ray Porter]] and won the 2022 [[Audie Award]] for [[Audie Award for Audiobook of the Year|Audiobook of the Year]].<ref>{{cite book |url=https://www.audible.com/pd/Project-Hail-Mary-Audiobook/B08G9PRS1K |title=Project Hail Mary by Andy Weir - Audiobook - Audible.com |date=May 4, 2021 |via=Audible.com |access-date=2021-05-12 |archive-date=June 3, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220603163532/https://www.audible.com/pd/Project-Hail-Mary-Audiobook/B08G9PRS1K |url-status=live }}</ref>

The novel was adapted into a [[Project Hail Mary (film)|film of the same name]] starring [[Ryan Gosling]], [[Sandra Hüller]], and [[James Ortiz]] (as the voice of Rocky, and one of the five puppeteers). [[Drew Goddard]] wrote the screenplay (his second Andy Weir adaptation), and [[Phil Lord and Christopher Miller]] co-directed.<ref name="variety2020">{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2020/film/news/ryan-gosling-astronaut-movie-hail-mary-1203547436/ |title=Ryan Gosling to Star in Astronaut Movie 'Project Hail Mary' |last=McNary |first=Dave |date=March 27, 2020 |publisher=Variety |access-date=2021-05-12 |archive-date=May 5, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250505022003/https://variety.com/2020/film/news/ryan-gosling-astronaut-movie-hail-mary-1203547436/ |url-status=live }}</ref> It was released in theaters on March 20, 2026.{{r|deadline-2014.04.18}}
